native.rules: RCD opening;neutral TestRecipes;whole-frame production50/50;64pixel crops,31pixel central measurements;selection onA only,reusedB;noTIFF

rules: Four previously reserved CanonR6III pairs ISO100/1600/6400/51200;historically inspected,not untouched final test. SHA verified despite moved paths. Fresh neutral linear Rec2020 rendering via current RCD+FlatOnly. First dark/flat/detail zones selected onA only,reusedB;64px samples central31. Production50/50 full-frame,versus scalar fixed h.4 NLM and binomial-pilot NLM. Both reconstructed original plane pixels. Differential D=(A-B)/sqrt2 calibrates marginal std and lag difference means outside guarded central33;pilot calibrated from smoothD,not source sigma. Same-pair calibration diagnostic,not blind production model. Proxy screening:noise ratio<=.8,crossloss<=1.05*production,mean shift<=.01*meanY,highpass cross-energy ratio>=.9 when positive. No perceptual or statistical acceptance claim.
limitations: No clean image truth;paired crossloss NOT clean MSE. Drift/motion/unequal or correlated noise and nonlinear RCD can invalidate noise interpretation. Outside-centre D calibration shares frames and may contain structure;no independence guarantee. Thresholds descriptive preregistered screening,not validated tolerances. Scalar per-plane candidates not complete color pipeline;noRGB gamut merge/compression. Pair regions may lack genuine small natural structures;photo review remains required. Full-frame production time and tiny-crop Python timings not comparable end-to-end.No production changes or TIFF generated.
